headline: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
summary: Slack introduces "Slackforce Surfaces" for AI-powered interactive tools. Users can build reports, polls, and dashboards directly in chats. Slackbot gathers info from conversations and connected apps.

headline: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
summary: AI companies are pitching AI education to schools using Big Tech's past strategies. They claim AI literacy is crucial for future jobs, warning students will fall behind. Companies offer free resources and curriculum to schools.

headline: Amazon’s Fire TV Stick 4K is over half off at under $20
summary: The Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K is on sale for $16.09 at Woot, over 50% off. Use coupon code FIRE30 at checkout to secure the deal. This offer is valid through September 13th.

headline: Electric air taxis get the green light for test flights in Texas
summary: Texas is launching test flights for electric, hybrid-electric, and autonomous aircraft. This federal program begins before official regulations for the technology are finalized. The FAA's eIPP selected Texas as one of eight states for this initiative.

headline: 'They Are Alchemy' — Guillermo Del Toro Speaks Out on AI in Filmmaking and Why It Can't Replace Human Creativity
summary: Filmmaker Guillermo Del Toro shares his strong opinions on AI in cinema. He argues that AI cannot replicate the essence of human creativity. Del Toro highlights the crucial elements lost when AI is used in the creative process.

headline: The Best iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max Cases
summary: Explore a comprehensive guide to the best cases for the iPhone 18 Pro. Discover top protective options for your new iPhone 18 Pro Max. Find the perfect case to suit your style and protection needs.

headline: Call of Duty's Anti-Cheat Boss Dispels Cheating Myths, Breaks Down Review Process, and More
summary: Call of Duty's anti-cheat director addresses common misconceptions about cheating in games. He details the robust review process used to combat dishonest players. The article highlights CoD's efforts against the multi-billion dollar cheating industry.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Recap and Review - The Once and Future Captain Kirk
summary: This article provides a recap and review of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4, Episode 8. Joe Morton delivers a compelling performance as the guest Admiral in 'Orders of Magnitude'. Paul Wesley's portrayal of James T. Kirk further develops in this episode.

headline: Labour mayors in England vow to cap tourist tax at 5%
summary: Labour mayors across England have pledged to cap the proposed tourist tax at 5%. The levy would apply to visitors' overnight stays in the region. Both Reform UK and the Conservatives have criticized these new tax plans.

headline: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
summary: Oil and gas prices have sharply increased amid escalating tensions in the Middle East. Global borrowing costs are also surging in response to the instability. Oil prices jumped to $105 a barrel as the Iran conflict shows no signs of quick resolution.

headline: Use all powers necessary on anti-migrant protests, home secretary tells police
summary: The home secretary has instructed police to use full powers against anti-migrant demonstrations. This directive follows recent protests held in Dover and Portsmouth. The government aims to ensure effective management of public order during such events.

headline: Can Trump pay $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win midterm elections?
summary: Analysts are questioning the feasibility of Trump's election-year promise to pay $5,000 to every adult. Concerns arise over the legality and affordability of such a payout. The offer is contingent on a Republican victory in the midterm elections.
